One control per role

1 — an explicit role attribute overrides the tag

LinkAsButton LinkAsTab
DivAsButton

A `<button role="tab">` is a TAB. Asking the page for a button by that name finds nothing — which is why every tabbed fixture had coverage 0.00 for months.

2 — <input> is eight roles, chosen by type

submit → button

3 — tags whose implicit role is not their tag name

RoleLink a[href] → link
select → combobox
select[multiple] → listbox, NOT combobox
textarea → textbox

4 — no role at all

`input[type=hidden]` has no role. Expected: perceived by the selector, dropped by the brain — and never reported as role "input".
